mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing the discount rate applied to future corporate earnings and increasing the present value of equities, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances despite a declining FEDFUNDS trend, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll growth above 200k per month signals strong labor market demand, which supports consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over any 2-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in residential investment (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) indicates strong underlying demand momentum, which increases corporate earnings visibility and reduces equity risk premiums, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX delivers positive 60-day returns in less than 40% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS rise, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in a multivariate regression.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 108.0 for two consecutive months signals weakening manufacturing activity, which increases the risk of a near-term earnings recession and triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 40% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the CPIAUCSL above 2.5% year-over-year, combined with a stable FEDFUNDS rate, signals persistent inflationary pressure that may force the Fed to delay rate cuts, increasing real interest rates and reducing equity valuation multiples, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 2.5 and FEDFUNDS <= 2.25, or the interaction term is not significant (p > 0.05) in a regression model.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in real personal consumption (RSAFS) below 525,000 million dollars, combined with a rising unemployment rate above 3.8%, indicates weakening consumer demand and labor market stress, which increases the probability of a near-term earnings downturn and triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX delivers negative 60-day returns in less than 40% of triggered instances, or the joint effect is not significant (p > 0.05) in a multivariate model.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate above 3.8% over a 3-month window, combined with a decline in non-farm payrolls, signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer confidence and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in less than 40% of instances where both conditions are met, or the interaction effect is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP growth (GDPC1) below 1.5% annualized, as measured over the past 5 months, indicates a weakening macroeconomic expansion, which increases the risk of a recession and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates negative 60-day returns in less than 40% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.
